extraction.Name: Maggie M. Romero
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but took it because she was told that if she did not, and pay the taxes that she would lose the land
extraction.Buyer: Sam Pelly for $800.00, Pelly living at Oelrichs, So. Dak.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was told that if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes that she would lose the land; has not paid the taxes on the rest
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health, having heart trouble; all she has is her equity in her land, which she knows very little about; has 3 minor children depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was granted; document sworn November 30, 1928
